summary: Humberside airspace restriction: traffic zone activated with set daily opening periods, some requiring prior permission.
text:

        2040-2135(PPR)
TUE-THU 0600-0630(PPR), 0730-0830, 0900-1100, 1200-1530, 1615-1800,
        2040-2135(PPR)
